_readme: The workflows the admin panel may start, and what each one accepts.
Read by TWO things, which is the whole reason it is a file and not a
Cloud Function will dispatch nothing that is not named here), and
admin/workflows.html fetches it (so the panel can list the buttons even
when the Function is not deployed and every button is a GitHub link).
Two copies of this list would drift, and the copy that drifted would be
the one deciding what a token is allowed to start.
It lives inside functions/ because `firebase deploy` uploads that
directory and nothing above it; a copy in admin/config/ could not be
Adding an entry here makes a workflow clickable. That is a deliberate
act: the ref is always main and is never caller-supplied, and only the
writes: 'nothing'  — reads the outside world, writes a report
'corpus'   — rewrites or republishes text people read

workflows.name: Check sources for updates
workflows.blurb: Looks at all 17 outside sources and reports what moved. Opens an issue if anything did. Imports nothing.

inputs.name: only
inputs.label: Only these source ids (comma-separated; blank = all)

inputs.name: remember
inputs.label: Record what was seen, so the next run reports only what is new

workflows.name: Kāvya tracker — refresh
workflows.blurb: Re-counts every kāvya on disk and rewrites KAVYA_TRACKER.md and kavya-status.json.

workflows.name: DGE re-index (search + library status)
workflows.blurb: Rebuilds the search index and publishes it to the search-dist branch.

inputs.name: open_pr
inputs.label: Open a pull request with the refreshed index

workflows.name: Import Kāvya corpus
workflows.blurb: Fetches kāvya from GRETIL, Ambuda and Wikisource and republishes the corpus. Rewrites text people read — leave "Probe only" on unless you mean it.

inputs.name: probe_only
inputs.label: Probe and report only — writes no data

inputs.name: open_pr
inputs.label: Open a pull request with the result

workflows.name: Publish the Sanskrit WordNet
workflows.blurb: Rebuilds the WordNet from the IndoWordNet dump and publishes it to the wordnet-dist branch.

inputs.name: languages
inputs.label: Other languages to carry equivalents from

inputs.name: examples
inputs.label: Include the usage sentences (24 MB with, 17 without)

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.label: Build and report only — publish nothing
